proposal.description: Power-good LED is also lit for the whole of S_RUN, on the belief that the supervisor only reaches S_RUN once the rail is in regulation, instead of following the comparator alone
proposal.reason: With run_active high and pgood low (the rail drops out of regulation while the converter is in S_RUN), pgood_LED stays lit instead of going dark on the next clock.

proposal.description: Outstanding strikes are shown solid while the converter is not switching (hiccup off-time, S_OFF) and blink only during the retry and run, so Red_LED1 looks like a latched trip during every hiccup
proposal.reason: With strike_level non-zero, no latch, and ss_active and run_active both low (S_HICCUP), Red_LED1 stays solidly lit instead of following the blink square wave.

proposal.description: Undervoltage indicator blinks with the strike timebase instead of being lit solid while input UVLO is live, the indicator map misremembered
proposal.reason: While uvlo_state stays high for longer than one blink half-period, Red_LED3 turns off and on with the blink square wave instead of staying lit.
